faq.title: What almost everyone
faq.description: Clear answers before you get in touch. If something is still unclear, ask us with no commitment.

items.a: It’s a one-time payment, with no monthly fees. Unless the contract says otherwise, 50% is paid upfront to start and the remaining 50% within 10 calendar days after the project is finished.

items.q: How long until my website is ready?
items.a: It depends on the plan and on how much content you have prepared. The exact timeline is set in the contract before we start.

items.q: What does each plan include, and what doesn’t it?
items.a: Each card lists what the plan includes. Any work outside that scope is quoted separately.

items.q: How many revisions can I ask for?
items.a: Revisions and deliverables are agreed in each project’s contract, so both sides know what to expect.

items.q: What do I need to have ready to start?
items.a: If you already have a logo, copy or photos, they’re a good starting point. If not, we’ll talk it through in the first consultation.

items.q: When do I get access and files?
items.a: Credentials and files are delivered once 100% of the project has been paid.

items.q: Does the consultation have a cost?
items.a: No. We look at your current situation and propose a tailored solution, with no commitment.

terms.intro: Every Astravia Studio project is governed by the contract signed with the client. These terms complement it and, in case of any difference, the contract prevails.
terms.contractText: The scope, deadlines, deliverables, revisions and cancellation conditions of each project are those set out in the contract. Any work outside that scope is quoted separately.
terms.paymentText: Unless the contract states otherwise, projects are paid in two parts:
terms.paymentBalance: The remaining 50% within 10 calendar days of the project being completed.
terms.deliveryText: Access credentials, files and other deliverables are handed over once 100% of the project has been paid. If the balance is not settled within 10 calendar days of the project being completed, Astravia Studio will withhold that delivery until payment is complete.
terms.cancelText: Cancellations are governed by what the contract states. Clients who hire as distance consumers may also exercise their right of withdrawal within 10 calendar days of hiring (art. 34, Law 24.240).
terms.lawText: These terms are governed by the laws of the Argentine Republic. Questions:

privacy.intro: At Astravia Studio we take the privacy of our visitors and contacts seriously. This page explains what information we collect and how we use it.
privacy.dataText: The only data we actively ask for is what you fill in on the contact form: name, email, phone (optional), the service you're interested in, and your message. That information is emailed to studioastravia@gmail.com through Mailtrap, our email delivery provider, and is used exclusively to respond to your inquiry.
privacy.cookiesText: We use Cloudflare Web Analytics to understand how the site is used (which pages are visited, from which country, on what type of device, etc.), in aggregate. It uses no cookies, stores nothing on your device and does not identify you personally, which is why we don't show a cookie notice.
privacy.antispamText: The form uses Cloudflare Turnstile to check that whoever is writing is a person and not an automated program. To do so, Cloudflare analyzes technical signals from your browser when the form loads. Astravia Studio does not receive or store that information.
privacy.contactText: If you have any questions about this policy or your data, you can reach us at studioastravia@gmail.com.

clients.title: Featured Projects
clients.description: Real, published projects where we test interface and performance ideas.

sendero.title: Sendero · Touring Bicycles
sendero.blurb: Custom frame workshop told as a logbook, with a built-in model comparison.
sendero.description: A custom frame workshop told in the voice of a field journal. The three models compare without leaving the page, and the process is explained with a dimensioned technical drawing instead of catalog photos. It is the only piece in the set without Tailwind: type and color live in a token system of its own.
sendero.alt: Sendero home: hero “Hasta donde se acaba el mapa” and workshop section with the frame drawing

serena.title: Serena · Yoga Studio
serena.blurb: Yoga studio with a weekly schedule filterable by day and direct booking.
serena.description: A yoga studio where everything pushes toward booking. The weekly grid filters by day without reloading the page, and every class shows teacher, level and duration before the visitor decides. It ships light and dark modes, which is what a site people check at seven in the morning and again late at night needs.
serena.alt: Serena home: hero about balancing body and mind and weekly schedule grid

nordica.title: Nórdica · Architecture Studio
nordica.blurb: Architecture studio told like a printed editorial.
nordica.description: An architecture studio told like a print editorial. The work gallery unfolds with the scroll: each project takes over the full screen and then hands it to the next. It closes with a materials showcase, and it all lives on a single page where typography carries the story.
nordica.alt: Nórdica home: hero “Espacios que cambian la forma de habitar” and materials mosaic

altamira.title: Altamira · Real Estate
altamira.blurb: Signature real estate site with filters that live in the URL and can be shared.
altamira.description: An auteur real estate site built as an SPA. Catalog filters live in the URL, so a search is shareable and survives refresh. Behind it all runs a video sequence tied to scroll without slowing loading.
altamira.alt: Altamira Real Estate home: property search and featured listings

oscuroCafe.title: Oscuro Café · Specialty Coffee
oscuroCafe.blurb: Specialty coffee shop with a warm, refined visual narrative.
oscuroCafe.description: A premium landing page for a specialty coffee shop designed to convey warmth and sophistication. The experience combines fluid animations and a visual narrative that invites you to discover the story behind each cup of coffee, while highlighting products and services.
oscuroCafe.alt: Oscuro Café home: hero with coffee and featured products

senderoKappa.title: Sendero Kappa · Outdoor Gear
senderoKappa.description: A premium landing page for an outdoor gear brand designed to convey adventure and quality. The experience combines fluid animations and a visual narrative that invites you to discover the story behind each product, while highlighting features and services.
senderoKappa.alt: Sendero Kappa home: outdoor gear and featured products

sonrisaelite.title: Sonrisa Élite · Modern Dental Clinic
sonrisaelite.blurb: Dental clinic with clear treatments, medical team and one-click appointments.
sonrisaelite.description: Website for a modern dental clinic offering general, cosmetic, and implant dentistry with advanced technology and personalized care. Features treatments, medical team profile, patient reviews, and before-and-after results.
sonrisaelite.alt: Dental clinic home: dentist with a patient, treatments and testimonials
